title: Thirdway footer
description: A full-width photo (480px phones, 606px desktop) with a cream call-to-action card at its bottom corner, then an ink footer: a huge vertical wordmark beside a tick ruler with a live 'You've scrolled N cm' label, address and contact details in small type with serif headings, large 32px page links, a small legal list and a credits bar.
notes: the footer panel forces the dark colour scope (cream on ink); the call-to-action card is a page-coloured panel (cream with ink type in the light theme)
the scroll counter needs JavaScript (hydrate: visible) and shows 0 until it hydrates
the original's small circled mark above the vertical wordmark is left out
